interaction.prompt: White has the puck in the corner and is looking to pass. Tap the opponent your team needs to cover first, before that pass turns into a scoring chance.

feedback.right: Yes! That white jersey is already in the slot — right in front of your goalie. Your teammate needs to push them out NOW, before the puck gets there.
feedback.wrong: The puck carrier and the point player are easy to see, but neither has a clean shot yet. The white jersey standing in the slot, right in front of your goalie, is the immediate danger — that is where goals come from.

tip: When the puck goes to the corner, scan the front of your net first. A player already parked there is a bigger threat than the puck carrier who is stuck in the corner.
why: U11 defenders fixate on the puck and lose track of the slot. This rep trains reading the net-front threat before the pass is made — the whole anticipation skill is seeing where the danger is BEFORE the puck arrives.
